propositions: Execution-phase plan-review re-reviews flag plan-vs-code discrepancies as violations even when the code already satisfies the plan's directed end state (false positive).
Pass-2 lacks a mechanism to drop such findings during execution review, blocking correct completed tickets from closing.
A new na-default binary sub-answer `current_state_satisfies_plan_goal` enables the verifier to assert that current code state already meets plan goals.

Pass-3 decision kernel must veto findings with `current_state_satisfies_plan_goal=yes` during execution review (when `execution_review=True` flag is set) and drop them with `reason=veto:plan-goal-satisfied`.
The veto is cohort-restricted to `registry.CODEBASE_GROUNDED` verifiers to ensure only code-grounded tools can perform present-state validation.
Planning-phase reviews and code-review calls are unaffected; the `execution_review` kwarg defaults False.
